builders.name: Boris Cherny
builders.summary_en: Claude Ship can coordinate code review, fixes, checks, and approvals under a team's repository policies. He recommends starting with one repository and observing approval decisions before trusting the workflow more broadly.

slang.definition_en: To release or deliver software.
slang.definition_zh: 发布或交付软件。

slang.definition_en: The pace at which a team completes and delivers work.
slang.definition_zh: 团队完成并交付工作的速度。

slang.definition_en: To repeatedly monitor and manually manage pull requests.

tweets.text:
Anyone can use /ship. If you’re on a Team or Enterprise plan, your admin can turn on Claude Ship per GitHub repo. I’d start with one repo and run Approvals in observe mode until you trust it.

https://t.co/p0T6zDSIwM

builders.name: Madhu Guru
builders.summary_en: Calling model development inputs merely 'data' can hide their value and complexity; they should not be treated as a commodity that can simply be bought and fed into a model. He also says he plans to share updates about a proposed meetup.
builders.summary_zh: 把模型开发所用的材料笼统称为「数据」，容易掩盖其价值和复杂性；它并非买来后直接投入模型的普通商品。他还表示会更新聚会筹备进展。

keywords.definition_zh: 指对某事的描述低估了它的真实价值或重要性。
keywords.example_zh: 他认为「数据」这个名称远未体现其在模型开发中的真正价值和复杂性。

keywords.definition_zh: 指被视为没有内在活力、可直接买卖替换的普通原料。
keywords.example_zh: 他批评外行把训练数据想象成买来后直接倒进模型的原料，忽视了其中的复杂工作。

keywords.definition_zh: 指设计、训练、评估和改进模型的开发过程。
keywords.example_zh: 他强调，只有接近模型开发实践的人，才更容易理解数据实际承载了什么。

tweets.text:
Part of the disconnect is that the name “data” massively undersells what it truly represents in model development.

People who are not close to model development think of data as this  inert commodity you buy and shovel into a model, like coal.

In reality great data encodes incredibly high value knowledge, taste and expertise, often articulated and structured in ways that did not exist previously. 

This makes it one of THE fundamental building blocks for creating increasingly capable intelligence across domains. 

Data will continue to be incredibly central to the intelligence industry .
tweets.summary_en: High-quality training data encodes knowledge, taste, and expertise rather than serving as an interchangeable commodity. It will remain a fundamental building block for increasingly capable AI.

builders.name: Aaron Levie
builders.summary_en: Service businesses have traditionally scaled by adding people, which limits how much customer demand they can serve. He also remarks on the unusually rapid pace of major news in 2026.
builders.summary_zh: 服务型企业过去主要靠增加人手扩大交付能力，因此难以无限承接客户需求。他还感叹 2026 年重大消息出现得异常密集。

slang.definition_en: Increasing a business's capacity to serve more customers.

keywords.definition_zh: 指组织中的员工人数或人员编制。
keywords.example_zh: 他指出，服务企业过去主要依靠增加员工人数扩大交付能力，因此难以无限承接需求。

keywords.definition_zh: 指为客户实现实际结果，而不只是提供活动或投入。
keywords.example_zh: 他把服务企业的增长瓶颈归结为替客户实现结果的能力，强调交付能力会限制需求转化。

keywords.definition_zh: 指扩大业务规模及其服务或交付能力。
keywords.example_zh: 这里讨论的是服务企业如何扩张，以及依赖增员的扩张方式为何形成限制。

tweets.text:
This is a pretty key insight. Services businesses are always held back by their ability to deliver outcomes to customers. 

That scaling essentially only could come from headcount, and no matter how much demand you saw, there was always a finite amount of talent you could get for the problem you were going after. Not to mention, the customer generally always wants the work done faster, at a lower price, or at a higher quality.

Agents entirely change the calculus here, because now we can scale output in a way that’s decoupled from the among of time that goes in. A single engineer can have the output of dozens of engineers before. A single designer can probably build out your entire design system and brand. And so on.

Well why isn’t this just all agents then? Because the key is to still have experts on the front end that actually can ensure the right outcomes are delivered from agents.

It’s likely that we’re going to see this in a wide variety of categories. You’ll see this in cyber security, advertising and marketing, legal, accounting, IT transformation, and a number of other historically people-only services industries.

It’s a great time if you’re starting one of these businesses, or if you have the capability to transform an existing one.
tweets.summary_en: AI agents could let services businesses scale output beyond headcount constraints, expanding opportunities across industries such as legal, accounting, marketing, and cybersecurity. Human experts remain essential to guide agents and ensure they deliver the right outcomes.

tweets.text: 2026 is just waking up each day to the magnitude of news that could only have happened once per decade before 2026.

tweets.text: How to prevent AI slop in design (without being a designer): https://t.co/xKfBQTQXns https://t.co/49RO5JiyR1

You can post on social media every day and still be a very private person; the two are not contradictory 

Many people have the misconception that sharing your thoughts online means turning your whole life into an open book for others to see. This can’t be further from the truth

I post almost every day but I only share a tiny sliver of my life & thoughts, probably less than 1%. I only share what I’m comfortable with sharing

The key is to find out which 1% is at the intersection of “interesting to others” and “comfortable for you”
tweets.summary_en: Posting frequently online is compatible with maintaining privacy. The key is sharing only the small slice of your thoughts and life that interests others and feels comfortable to disclose.

slang.definition_zh: 严重到可能使组织无法继续存在的危机。

keywords.definition_zh: 指威胁组织生存或根本存在基础的危机。
keywords.example_zh: 他认为，组织若熬过生存危机，可能因为亲眼见过失败的可能性而变得更强硬。

keywords.definition_zh: 指抱着极强的攻击性或必胜决心，准备采取强硬行动。
keywords.example_zh: 他用这个比喻描述危机幸存组织的战斗意志，并非指实际暴力。

keywords.definition_zh: 指通过股票、债券等渠道筹集和配置中长期资金的市场。
keywords.example_zh: 他把美国的资本市场基础与创业生态并列，认为这些条件受到其他国家和个人的向往。

tweets.text:
Most good organizations when faced with an existential crisis that doesn’t destroy them will return meaner and out for blood.

They have seen what failure could look like and are ready to go to war to make sure that never happens.

I felt this over and over again at Meta. 

Nvidia isn’t going to hold back now.

Sometimes you need to travel abroad to deeply appreciate just how inspirational America is to the rest of the world.

Countries and individuals aspire to have an entreprenurial ecosystem like ours. A capital market base like ours.

They don't want to be like China or the UK or Denmark. 

They want to be like America.

And this is particularly true for the most ambitious people in every country. They are students of how America builds.

This doesn't mean we cannot do better ourselves. We must and we will.
tweets.summary_en: America’s entrepreneurial ecosystem and capital markets remain an aspirational model for ambitious people around the world. That international appeal coexists with the need for continued improvement at home.

builders.summary_en: He strongly endorses an unspecified item and separately expresses enthusiasm about Jensen. The available text does not identify the item or explain the Jensen reference.
builders.summary_zh: 他高度称赞了一项未说明的内容，并单独表达了对 Jensen 的兴奋之情。现有文字无法确定被称赞的内容或 Jensen 相关事件。

builders.name: Claude
builders.summary_en: Claude now groups connectors and skills into plugins, available on several individual plans, with organizational plans to follow. It also says EFS is available across several Claude hosting options, with Microsoft Foundry support planned.
builders.summary_zh: Claude 将连接器与技能整合为插件，已面向多个个人订阅档位开放，团队和企业档位将随后支持。EFS 已覆盖多个 Claude 托管渠道，并计划支持 Microsoft Foundry。

slang.definition_en: Add-ons that extend an AI assistant with tool connections or reusable abilities.
slang.definition_zh: 为 AI 助手添加工具连接或可复用能力的扩展组件。

slang.definition_en: Integrations that let an AI assistant access external tools or services.
slang.definition_zh: 让 AI 助手接入外部工具或服务的集成组件。

keywords.definition_zh: 指让 AI 接入外部工具、服务或数据源的连接组件。
keywords.example_zh: 公告表示，连接器将与技能一起整合进插件，统一 Claude 接入工具的方式。

keywords.definition_zh: 在此指用于教 AI 按特定方法完成任务的可复用指令或能力包。
keywords.example_zh: 公告把技能与连接器组合起来，让插件既能连接工具，也能教 Claude 新的做事方法。

keywords.definition_zh: 指可安装的扩展包，用于为软件增加工具连接或特定能力。
keywords.example_zh: Claude 宣布以插件统一承载连接器和技能，并说明个人套餐已经上线、组织套餐稍后推出。

tweets.text:
There’s now one way to connect your tools to Claude, teach it a new skill, or do both.

Connectors and skills come together as plugins. Live on Free, Pro, Max, and Ultra plans, with Team and Enterprise coming soon.

Browse 10,000+ plugins: https://t.co/gSwpY9HDPY https://t.co/K78lwls8qh
EFS is available on the Claude Platform, Claude Platform on AWS, Amazon Bedrock, and Claude on Google Cloud. Support for EFS in Microsoft Foundry is coming soon.

vocab.definition_en: A critical stage at which a small change can trigger a much larger shift.
vocab.definition_zh: 临界点；微小变化可能引发重大转变的关键阶段。
vocab.example_en: Support from another major lab could be the tipping point for industry cooperation.
vocab.example_zh: 另一家大型实验室的支持可能成为行业合作的转折点。

vocab.definition_en: Speed in a particular direction; in software work, the pace at which a team delivers work.
vocab.definition_zh: 速度；在软件开发语境中，指个人或团队交付工作的速率。
vocab.example_en: Automated reviews increased our development velocity.
vocab.example_zh: 自动化审查提高了我们的开发速度。

vocab.definition_en: The underlying systems and services that other activities depend on.
vocab.definition_zh: 基础设施；其他活动赖以运行的底层系统和服务。
vocab.example_en: Many applications depend on shared open-source infrastructure.
vocab.example_zh: 许多应用依赖共用的开源基础设施。

vocab.definition_en: To update software to fix a bug or security weakness.
vocab.definition_zh: 打补丁；通过更新软件修复错误或安全漏洞。
vocab.example_en: The engineers patched the vulnerability before the next release.
vocab.example_zh: 工程师在下次发布前修补了这个安全漏洞。

vocab.definition_en: With intense, persistent attention that can be difficult to stop.
vocab.definition_zh: 执着地；以强烈、持续甚至难以停止的专注投入某事。
vocab.example_en: She obsessively checked every failing test for clues.
vocab.example_zh: 她执着地检查每个失败的测试，寻找线索。

vocab.definition_en: Containing software errors that cause unexpected or unreliable behavior.
vocab.definition_zh: 有程序错误的；运行不稳定或出现异常行为的。
vocab.example_en: The new feature is useful but still buggy.
vocab.example_zh: 这个新功能很有用，但仍有不少程序错误。

quote.text_en: Well done is better than well said.
quote.author: Benjamin Franklin

slang_glossary.definition_en: An extremely enthusiastic fan; also a verb meaning to strongly support someone.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 狂热粉丝；也可作动词，表示强烈支持或喜爱某人。

slang_glossary.definition_en: The threshold beyond which a major change becomes likely or self-sustaining.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 引发重大转变、或使变化开始自行持续的临界点。

slang_glossary.definition_en: To release or deliver software or a feature to users.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 发布或交付软件、产品或功能。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A slash command presented in the sample as an entry point to Claude Ship.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 样本文本中用于调用 Claude Ship 的斜杠命令。

slang_glossary.definition_en: The pace of development or delivery; in agile methods, it can refer to work completed per iteration.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 开发或交付速度；在敏捷方法中，也可指每轮迭代完成的工作量。

slang_glossary.definition_en: To repeatedly monitor and manage pull requests until they are ready to merge.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 像照看孩子一样持续盯着拉取请求，处理问题并推动合并。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Short for pull request: a proposal to merge code changes into a repository.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: pull request 的缩写，即拉取请求：提议将代码更改合并到代码仓库。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Short for repository: a place where project code and its change history are stored.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: repository 的简称，即存放项目代码及其变更历史的代码仓库。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Inspection of proposed code changes to identify problems and improve quality.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 代码审查：检查拟议的代码更改，以发现问题并提高质量。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Automated tests or validation steps that report unsuccessful results.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 未通过的自动化测试或验证步骤。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A mode used to watch and assess a system's decisions before allowing it to take action.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 观察模式：先观察和评估系统决策，再允许其实际执行操作。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A prerelease stage in which users try software that may still change or contain bugs.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 测试阶段；用户可以试用，但软件仍可能调整或存在错误。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Open-source software: software whose source code is available under a license permitting use, modification, and redistribution.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 开源软件：源代码按允许使用、修改和再分发的许可证公开的软件。

slang_glossary.definition_en: To make a product or update available, often gradually across users.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 推出或逐步开放产品、功能或更新。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Informal language for software that contains errors or behaves unreliably.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 形容软件有错误、运行不稳定的口语说法。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Giving an AI model instructions or context to guide its response.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 向 AI 模型提供指令或上下文，以引导其回答或行为。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Informally, annoyed, resentful, or bitter about something.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 口语中指不爽、愤愤不平或心有怨气。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A mildly censored abbreviation of bullshit, used to dismiss something as nonsense or unfair.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: bullshit 的缩写，带粗俗色彩，用来表示「胡扯」或「太不合理了」。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A small central team designed to operate with limited staffing and overhead.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 精简的核心团队，以较少人员和管理成本开展工作。

slang_glossary.definition_en: AI whose trained model weights are available to download, subject to license terms; other development materials may remain private.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 开放模型权重的 AI，可按许可条款下载权重；训练数据等其他材料可能仍不公开。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Increasing commitment or investment in an existing strategy.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 继续加码；对已有策略投入更多资源或承诺。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Increasing a system's size, capacity, resources, or reach.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 扩大系统规模、容量、资源投入或覆盖范围。

slang_glossary.definition_en: For an AI system to generate instructions or questions that guide its own subsequent steps.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: AI 系统自行生成提示或问题，以引导后续步骤。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A headline label signaling newly emerging news, sometimes used for dramatic emphasis.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 表示「突发消息」的标题标签，有时也用于夸张地吸引注意。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A dismissive term for low-quality, generic, or mass-produced AI-generated content.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 对低质量、模板化或批量生成的 AI 内容的贬称。

slang_glossary.definition_en: In AI, a group of agents working on tasks, often through coordination or parallel activity.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 在 AI 语境中，指通过协作或并行活动执行任务的一组智能体。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An engineer who works closely with customers to adapt and implement a product in their environment.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 前线部署工程师；深入客户实际环境，协助产品适配与落地的工程师。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An individual's own tasks or criteria for judging a tool's performance.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 个人评测基准；用自己关心的任务或标准衡量工具表现。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An internet suffix or term for aggressively optimizing or maximizing a particular trait or activity.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 网络用语，指把某项特质或活动尽可能优化、拉满。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Deep uncertainty about purpose or identity; online, often used humorously for feeling fundamentally unsettled.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 对存在意义或身份的深刻困惑；网络上也常夸张地表示受到冲击、开始怀疑人生。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Add-on components that extend an application's capabilities.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 插件；为应用扩展功能的附加组件。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Integrations that let an application access or interact with external services and data.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 连接器；让应用访问外部服务、数据或与之交互的集成组件。
